mirror_contract.current_rebase_note: The schema 2.0 registry contains one record per Moon Source public capability. Architectural role and distribution role are independent; standalone distribution is a delivery profile, not a competing semantic class. Connected Sources remains the structural crown jewel at docs/CONNECTED_SOURCES.md and is standalone-capable at 1.2. The five Moon Source standalone distributions retain self-onboarding canonical bodies and exact package/mirror byte contracts. Adaptive Orchestration Protocol is an independent external protocol, excluded from this registry; its legacy pointers and package projections are checked through downloads/external-projections/aop-compatibility.json. No method version bump is earned by this structural registry rebase.
mirror_contract.rule: Moon Source is the semantic and versioning authority for capabilities recorded here. Adaptive Orchestration Protocol is governed by its own canonical repository and is linked as a related external protocol. LUAHELENA mirrors current Moon Source canonical bodies and exposes registered standalone distributions as convenience delivery surfaces.
update_procedure: Update the canonical capability body in Moon Source first.
Run scripts/validate_public_capabilities.py and the preserved link, licensing, stamp and title/version checks.
Copy exact canonical UTF-8 bytes to the mapped LUAHELENA mirror path on a branch.
Keep website open links pointed at canonical Moon Source bodies and keep download links pointed at standalone delivery surfaces.
Run scripts/check_mirror_sync.py against the remote mirror or a local LUAHELENA checkout.
Open and review a website pull request; merge only after SHA-256 equality and facade review.
Verify independent AOP compatibility projections with scripts/check_aop_compatibility.py; this check is read-only and does not generate or publish artifacts.
